hero.title: Recovery begins with a clear first step.
hero.description: Physiotherapy is not a one-size-fits-all prescription. Every journey begins with understanding your condition, building an approach around your needs, and tracking progress over time.

trajectory.title: A Structured Care Trajectory
trajectory.description: An analytical and progressive sequence taking you from apprehension toward full kinetic independence.

assessment.title: Assessment
assessment.description: A full movement and functional evaluation before any treatment begins.
assessment.details: We start by understanding your history, movement patterns, and the goals you're working toward.

planning.title: Planning
planning.description: A personalized roadmap with clear milestones.
planning.details: We design a plan that addresses the root cause — not just symptoms — with clear phases.

treatment.title: Treatment
treatment.description: Hands-on care combined with progressive loading.
treatment.details: Manual therapy, movement re-education, and guided exercise progression.

followUp.title: Follow-up
followUp.description: Home program and checkpoints to keep progress on track.
followUp.details: We give you the tools to continue independently, with periodic check-ins to confirm lasting results.

listen.title: Why Listen & Understand First?
listen.description: Pain is not an isolated signal; it is influenced by daily habits, stress, and movement fear. Understanding your daily context allows us to design rehabilitation around your actual lifestyle.

testing.title: Objective Testing & Safe Progression
testing.description: We rely on measurable force output, range-of-motion angles, and limb symmetry to validate your progress before advancing difficulty.

vision.quote: The goal is not only to feel better today, but to understand your body and rebuild confidence in movement.
vision.author: Dr. Mohamed Gamil
